name: Checkbox Group
summary: A set of checkboxes that share one name and belong to one field. The group is a fieldset, so the browser groups the boxes for the form and for the screen reader.
summaryZh: 一组共用同一个名字、同属一个字段的复选框。组是一个 fieldset,所以表单和读屏都会把这些方框当成一组。

variants.name: Stacked
variants.note: One option per row, running down the panel. The base class on its own is this layout, and the modifier paints the same thing so the class list can name it.

variants.name: Inline
variants.note: The options run across the panel and wrap onto the next line when they run out of room.

states.name: Checked
states.note: A ticked option takes the brand colour's own soft tint, and its text takes the foreground that was derived for that tint.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The label takes the derived disabled colour and the box dims, the way every other disabled control in the library dims.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The ring goes on the box, because the box is what the user actually sees of the control.

parts.name: Legend
parts.note: The fieldset's own legend. It is the group's name, and the browser reads it before the options.

parts.name: Options
parts.note: The panel that holds the options. It carries the group's surface and the space between the options.

parts.name: Option
parts.note: One option. It is the label that wraps the real input, the box and the text, so it is the element that can be asked whether its input is ticked. The box itself is the checkbox component's own.

props.name: name
props.description: The name every option in the group submits under. It is the native name attribute, so the form posts every ticked option as one field.
props.descriptionZh: 组里每个选项提交时用的名字。它是原生 name 属性,所以表单会把每一个勾上的选项作为同一个字段提交。

props.name: value
props.description: The value one option submits while it is ticked.
props.descriptionZh: 某个选项勾上时提交的值。

props.name: checked
props.description: Ticks one option. It is the native checked attribute, not a class.
props.descriptionZh: 勾上某一个选项。它是原生 checked 属性,不是某个类。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes one option inert. It uses the real disabled attribute, so it leaves the tab order.
props.descriptionZh: 让某一个选项不可用。它用的是原生 disabled 属性,因此会退出 Tab 顺序。

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the options run. The stacked run is the base class on its own; the inline run adds um-checkbox-group--inline.
props.descriptionZh: 选项往哪个方向排。纵向是只写基础类;横向再加上 um-checkbox-group--inline。

props.name: label
props.description: The text of the group's legend. A group with no legend still needs an accessible name of its own.
props.descriptionZh: 组标题的文字。不写标题的组也得有自己的可访问名称。

slots.name: legend
slots.description: The legend text, above the options.

slots.name: option
slots.description: One option: the real input, the checkbox component's box and the text.
slots.descriptionZh: 一个选项:真正的 input、复选框组件的方框和文字。

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when an option is ticked or unticked. It is the browser's own event on the input — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 某个选项被勾选或取消勾选时触发。这是 input 上的浏览器原生事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

a11y.notes: The group is a real <fieldset> with a real <legend>, so the screen reader announces the group's name before the options and reports how many boxes there are. Every option is a real <input type="checkbox"> inside a <label>, so ticking it is the browser's :checked, the value submits with the form and nothing needs JavaScript. The input is hidden visually rather than removed from the accessibility tree, so it keeps its place in the tab order and its label.
a11y.notesZh: 组是一个真正的 <fieldset>,配一个真正的 <legend>,所以读屏会先报出组的名字,再报出方框的数量。每个选项都是 <label> 里一个真正的 <input type="checkbox">,勾选走的就是浏览器的 :checked,值会随表单提交,完全不需要 JavaScript。这个 input 只是视觉隐藏,没有被移出无障碍树,因此它仍在 Tab 顺序里,也仍然有标签。

examples.title: Stacked
examples.description: One option per row. A ticked option takes the brand colour's soft tint, and the row knows it is ticked because it holds the input.
examples.descriptionZh: 一行一个选项。勾上的选项会带上品牌色的浅色底,而这一行知道自己是勾上的,因为 input 就在它里面。
examples.markup: Delivery

examples.title: Inline
examples.description: The options run across the panel and wrap onto the next line. Only the modifier class changes; the markup is the same.
examples.descriptionZh: 选项横向排开,放不下就换行。变的只有那个修饰类,标记是同一份。
examples.markup: Channels

notes: The group owns the row and the text of an option, but not the box: the box and the real input are the checkbox component's own classes, so a tick inside a group is drawn exactly like a tick outside one. The group has no sizes of its own, because the box's size belongs to the box — a group cannot make the control it holds bigger without redrawing it. The selected row is found with :has(), which is the only way CSS can ask an element what its child is doing.
notesZh: 组拥有选项这一行和它的文字,但不拥有方框:方框和真正的 input 都是复选框组件自己的类,所以组里的对勾和组外的对勾画得一模一样。组本身没有尺寸,因为方框的大小归方框管 —— 组想让它里面的控件变大,就得把控件重画一遍。选中的那一行是用 :has() 找到的,这是 CSS 唯一能问元素「你孩子现在怎么样」的办法。
